behaviors.filter-by-person: Selecting Priya or Marco shows only tasks assigned to that person and updates the task summary.
behaviors.search-assignees: Typing a name in the assignee dropdown narrows its person options.
behaviors.filter-unassigned: Selecting Unassigned shows the seed task with no assignee.
behaviors.combine-filters: Selecting both a status and an assignee shows only tasks matching both choices.
behaviors.empty-assignee-state: Selecting Ana shows “Nothing assigned to Ana Lima yet” with a Clear filters button.
behaviors.clear-filters: Clear filters resets both controls to All statuses and Anyone and restores the full task list.

history.notes: The tour scopes assignee text to the toolbar to distinguish dropdown choices from task cards, and scopes the empty-state Clear filters button to its container. It assumes the custom dropdown displays its selected label and exposes its search input through the supplied placeholder.

The dropdown popup is mounted outside the toolbar, so person options are located through `.dd-popup.open`; the toolbar’s `.dd-button` identifies the assignee control. The tour assumes the documented fresh seed data.
